easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
description:
Cast Bag End Banquet by paying {6}.
When Bag End Banquet enters, it triggers itself and Grinding Station.
Resolve the Bag End Banquet trigger, creating three Food tokens.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding at least six {C}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bag End Banquet.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Bag End Banquet from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
